interpretation: All metrics are own-branch trajectories, including conditional FINISH readouts; no teacher-driven score is present.
First-error causes use only primary eligible requests with matured deadlines; idle actions and canceled requests have separate populations.
Counterfactuals change future receipts and hidden states, so rescue deltas are not pure isolated information-content effects.

A correct retained old FINISH readout plus WAIT is appropriate inhibition, not a failure to erase content.
